description: The closed-scope A/B again (after m4-closed-scopes-typer, job 591) with retronym/scala#241's owner-aware suspension (a closed scope is suspended for a cache fill only when the cache's owner outlives it) and closed scopes around implicit search's compatibility checks, plus the control that was missing: the chunked weak table without closed scopes. All on retronym/scala#212 with scala/scala#11381. Separate forks, scala corpus to `-Ystop-after:typer`, one compile at a time, 8 GB G1, patched JDK 26, M4.
